Figure 04 reaches design lock as Index uploads reach 37.5 million

An all-hands recording details component testing and a Helix 3.0 teaser, without pricing, delivery dates or standardized hand benchmarks.

Humanoids Daily ↗23 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1Videos 2

New hardware enters component testing

Figure’s October 22 all-hands recording says Figure 04 has reached design lock and parts are shipping. Actuators are in the test lab and ten complete battery packs were brought up the previous week, with load and thermal testing still ahead. This is not a customer-delivery announcement.

Hands and human data evolve together

Brett Adcock described the fourth hand iteration, designed to better reproduce human motion. Figure reports 37.5 million Index video uploads across 112 countries. Upload totals are not equivalent to cleaned training data, and claims of human-like dexterity lack a standardized benchmark.

Helix 3.0 remains a preview

The presentation teased Helix 3.0 without a full capability disclosure or release date. This update concerns next-generation hardware and training, distinct from the earlier Figure 03 treadmill endurance story. It does not establish reliable general-purpose operation.
